name: femora
description: Write and understand Python code for Femora and OpenSees models.

interface.longDescription: Write and explain Femora Python code using bundled exact API signatures, concept guides, and worked examples. Get help with soils, piles, buildings, meshing, assembly, interfaces, loads, analysis, recorders, workflows, jobs, and results. The plugin provides coding guidance; it does not run simulations or submit jobs itself. Validate generated code in your own Femora environment.
